title: InternLM2 Technical Report
data_curation: Pre-training uses 2.0-2.6T tokens across text, code, and long-context data. Text (webpages 86.5% of bytes, plus books, papers, patents) is processed via Trafilatura extraction, pycld2 language ID, heuristic rule cleaning, MinHash LSH dedup (128 hashes, 5-gram, 0.7 threshold), safety filtering (13M blocked domains, 36k blocked words, BERT toxicity/pornography classifiers), and quality filtering with BERT ads/fluency classifiers trained on manual annotations. Code data (105.6GB high / 440.1GB moderate / 83.85GB low-dropped) is unified to markdown, deduped at file level, quality-scored via an iterative annotation loop, and dependency-sorted by topological sort so whole repositories become single long files. Long-context data (>32KB) uses length, statistical, and conditional-perplexity filters and is a subset of the standard corpus (learned at least twice). A 24B-token capability-enhancement set mixes retrieved STEM/special-domain and high-quality HuggingFace data; test-related data is filtered with a contamination check. SFT uses 10M screened ChatML instructions; the reward model uses 2.4M binarized preference pairs. The tokenizer is cl100k-derived (~60k EN/code + 32k Chinese).
curriculum: Training proceeds in three pre-training phases then alignment. Phase 1 (~90% of steps) trains at <=4k context. Phase 2 (~9% of steps) introduces 50% <=32k data and raises the RoPE base from 50k to 1M. Phase 3 is capability-specific enhancement on 24B high-quality tokens with smaller LR/batch size. English, Chinese, and code are mixed throughout. Alignment is SFT (10M ChatML instructions, 1 epoch, AdamW lr 4e-5) followed by COOL RLHF over three online rounds. Long-context pre-training data is reused in SFT and RLHF to preserve long-context ability, and tool/agent capability is added via Agent-FLAN-style disentanglement and a RICO code-interpreter strategy. The authors release checkpoints at every stage - InternLM2-{size}-Base, InternLM2-{size} (post-enhancement), -Chat-{size}-SFT, and -Chat-{size} (post-RLHF) - to expose the staged evolution.
method: COOL RLHF (Conditional Online RLHF) is the core contribution. To resolve conflicting preferences (helpful vs. harmless, math, code), a single Conditional Reward Model is conditioned on domain-specific system prompts instead of maintaining multiple reward models (LLaMA2-style). Its loss is a focal ranking loss with a difficulty-decay coefficient (gamma=2) plus a log-barrier penalty confining scores to [-5,5] (lambda=0.02). To fight reward hacking, Online RLHF runs three rounds with a Fast Path (20-100 preference patches per round contrasting early/late PPO responses) and a Slow Path (human-labeled pairs across SFT/early/late PPO models to raise the reward upper bound). PPO uses four same-size models; the critic is initialized from the reward model with a 50-iteration warmup, a pre-train gradient term (coeff 0.5), KL=0.01, PPO lambda=0.99, top-p=0.9, and no value clipping or advantage normalization, over ~200k queries/~400 iterations.
eval_metrics: Evaluation covers 6 dimensions and 30 benchmarks via OpenCompass. Exams: MMLU, CMMLU, C-Eval, AGIEval, GAOKAO. Language/knowledge: TriviaQA, NaturalQuestions, C3, RACE-High, FLORES (BLEU). Reasoning/math: WinoGrande, HellaSwag, BBH, GSM8K, MATH, TheoremQA, MathBench. Coding: HumanEval, MBPP, MBPP-CN, HumanEval-X. Long-context: L-Eval, LongBench, 200k Needle-in-a-Haystack. Tools: T-Eval, CIBench under ReAct with a code interpreter. Alignment: AlpacaEval (win rate), MTBench (0-10), AlignBench, CompassArena (win rate), IFEval (accuracy). A GSM8K contamination check compares LM loss on train/test/reference splits (delta1, delta2). Headline numbers: InternLM2-Chat-20B reaches AlpacaEval 21.8, MTBench 7.9, AlignBench 6.8, CompassArena 31.4, GSM8K 79.6, MATH 32.4, HumanEval 67.7, and near-perfect 200k Needle-in-a-Haystack recall, beating GPT-3.5 on HellaSwag (+15.6) and BBH (+26.4).
key_results: InternLM2-Chat-20B: AlpacaEval win rate 21.8 (SOTA among compared), GSM8K 79.6, MATH 32.4, HumanEval 67.7, MTBench 7.9, AlignBench 6.8, and near-perfect 200k Needle-in-a-Haystack, beating GPT-3.5 on reasoning. InternLM2-7B lifts GSM8K from 36.0 (base) to 70.8 and scores MMLU 65.8.
evolution_note: COOL RLHF refines LLaMA2's separate helpful/harmless reward models into a single system-prompt-conditioned reward model and adds multi-round online patching against reward hacking, extending InstructGPT-style PPO. It reflects the 2024 open-LLM push for transparent data pipelines and staged alignment, and anticipates later iterative/online RLHF and process-reward trends.
